pwa.title: Install Movemall
pwa.description: Shop faster and get deal notifications.
pwa.manualInstructions:
To install the Movemall app:
- On iOS (Safari): tap Share, then select ‘Add to Home Screen’.
- On Android (Chrome): open the three-dot menu, then select ‘Install app’.
